lede: Specialist engine rebuild for Land Rover SVR and SV performance models — AJ133 supercharged V8, BMW S68 twin-turbo V8 and Ingenium performance engines, rebuilt to OEM specification.

sections.heading: What a Land Rover SVR/SV Performance Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: A performance engine rebuild for SVR or SV models is more than a standard engine overhaul. These are high-output engines with specific components, calibrations and tolerances that require specialist knowledge and precise procedures.

items: **AJ133 5.0L Supercharged V8** — Fitted to Range Rover Sport SVR, Range Rover SVAutobiography, Velar SVAutobiography Dynamic Edition
**BMW S68 4.4L Twin-Turbo V8** — Fitted to Defender Octa
**Ingenium AJ300P 6-Cylinder Petrol** — Fitted to performance variants of modern models

blocks.html: Each performance engine rebuild starts with a full strip-down and inspection. We machine components to performance tolerances, replace all wear items with OEM or SVR-specific components, and reassemble to factory specification. The process ends with a high-load road test to validate performance and durability.

items: **AJ133 supercharged V8:** Requires supercharger rebuild — bearings, oil, sealing components and coupler all replaced as part of the service.
**BMW S68 (Defender Octa):** Requires BMW-specific tooling and diagnostic equipment — hot-vee twin-turbo configuration adds complexity.
**Ingenium AJ300P:** Performance-spec components and precise calibration matching for modern models.

blocks.html: Our rebuilds follow OEM specification for each specific performance variant, including correct ECU calibration and mapping.
[Read more about our workshop](/about) — decades of combined hands-on experience across every Land Rover variant.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions — Performance Engine Rebuilds

items.q: What's the difference between a standard and a performance engine rebuild?
items.a: A performance engine rebuild uses OEM specification components for the specific SVR or SV variant. This includes SVR-specific pistons, rings, bearings and gaskets — not standard-spec parts. The calibration and mapping are also matched to the performance variant. For AJ133 engines, the supercharger is fully rebuilt with new bearings, oil, seals and coupler.

items.q: Do you rebuild the BMW S68 engine in the Defender Octa?
items.a: Yes. We rebuild the BMW S68 twin-turbo V8 fitted to the Defender Octa. This requires BMW-specific tooling and diagnostic equipment due to the hot-vee configuration. All components are replaced to OEM specification.

items.q: How long does a performance engine rebuild take?
items.a: A performance engine rebuild typically takes 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop. This includes strip-down, machining, reassembly, calibration and high-load road testing. Complex jobs (AJ133 with supercharger rebuild or S68 hot-vee) may take longer depending on component availability.

items.q: Do you rebuild the supercharger as part of an AJ133 rebuild?
items.a: Yes. As standard, we replace supercharger bearings, oil, sealing components and the coupler. This is included in the rebuild price — not an optional extra.

items.q: What warranty comes with a performance engine rebuild?
items.a: Every rebuild comes with our standard 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, covering parts and labour for the rebuilt engine.

items.q: Can you rebuild a performance engine that's been badly damaged?
items.a: We assess each engine on a case-by-case basis. A full strip-down inspection determines whether the block, crank or cylinder head are salvageable. If the damage is too extensive, we can advise on replacement options instead.
